title: Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance
abstract: arXiv:2611.14323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model systems use self-judgment to decide which answers to release, review, or recompute. Because intervention is costly, an assurance score must rank errors well at the available budget, not merely over the full ranking. We compare the judge's continuous verdict-token score with a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations from the same prompt. Exact identities link fixed-budget error recall to residual risk and show that AUROC averages recall over all budgets. Across three open 7-12B models on GSM8K and MATH, the probe finds 1.3-22.5 additional percentage points of errors at 5% review in all six model-dataset settings (median 7.4 points). At 10% routing, probe-guided allocation improves accuracy over equal-cost random allocation in both GSM8K experiments, but beats judge-guided routing only for the weaker judge. Cross-dataset transfer lowers probe AUROC for every model in both directions relative to tar

translated_title: 审计裁判者：用于大语言模型推理保障的内部信号
translated_abstract: 语言模型系统使用自我判断来决定哪些答案可以发布、复审或重新计算。由于干预成本高昂，一个保障分数必须在可用预算内对错误进行良好排序，而不仅仅是在完整排名上表现良好。我们将裁判者的连续判定token分数与在同一提示的注意力头激活上训练的监督式正确性探针进行比较。通过精确的恒等式将固定预算下的错误召回率与残余风险联系起来，并表明AUROC是所有预算下召回率的平均值。在GSM8K和MATH数据集上的三个开源7-12B模型中，在所有六种模型-数据集设置下，探针在5%复审预算下额外发现了1.3-22.5个百分点的错误（中位数为7.4个百分点）。在10%路由比例下，探针引导的分配在两项GSM8K实验中都比同等成本的随机分配提高了准确率，但仅在裁判者较弱时才优于裁判引导的路由。跨数据集迁移时，探针的AUROC在两个方向上相对于目标数据集内的表现均有所下降。
tldr: 该论文提出用注意力头激活训练的监督式正确性探针来审计大语言模型的自我裁判机制，证明在固定审查预算下探针比裁判自身的置信分数能发现更多推理错误。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations to audit LLM self-judgment, demonstrating that under fixed review budgets the probe detects substantially more reasoning errors than the judge's own verdict-token scores.
